objective_value: <float> Total penalty cost summed over roster-rule violations, nurse-skill mismatches, unmet preferences, and unsatisfied demand.
schedule: <dict[dict[str]], outer key: '{nurse_id}', inner key: 'day_{day}'> Shift assigned to each nurse on each day of the horizon, taking a work-shift name or 'None' for a day off.
skill_assignments: <dict[dict[str]], outer key: '{nurse_id}', inner key: 'day_{day}'> Complete skill witness parallel to schedule: one skill name on every worked day and 'None' on every day off.
